selection.question: Pickup/lift and release versus matching endpoints by pushing

source_review.observation: Initial block upper-left and oblique; fingers surround it before a lifted transport over the square; the hand withdraws and the upright block remains.
source_review.limit: Support forces, exact contact/release time and metric lift height are not measured.

interpretation: Existing retrieval/goal-similarity quantities are descriptive offline results, not causal phase accuracy. No new similarity metric, fit or threshold selection.

selection.question: Observed held transport and user-labelled pause; is waiting independently required?

source_review.observation: Left/upright source, hand-held intermediate block, then transport and upright placement. User-labelled pause/resume; seven-frame review alone does not measure a pause duration.
source_review.limit: VIDEO07 has finer sampled evidence of reduced progress and resumption; neither it nor the task specification makes waiting mandatory.

interpretation: Existing retrieval/goal-similarity quantities are descriptive offline results, not causal phase accuracy. No new similarity metric, fit or threshold selection.

selection.question: Preserve already-completed state without needless manipulation

source_review.observation: Correct-looking block remains in the square and no hand/manipulation is visible at all seven inspected paired instants.
source_review.limit: Samples support no-action intent; they do not prove zero movement between every frame. Goal recognition can already use an initial goal observation.

interpretation: Existing retrieval/goal-similarity quantities are descriptive offline results, not causal phase accuracy. No new similarity metric, fit or threshold selection.
